prompts.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: transparent PNG sprite for a 2D hand-drawn doodle game.
Create ONE handprint-shaped crater in the ground, using reference image 1 (existing meteor crater) for EXACT simple thick black wobbly outline, sandy tan rim, dark brown recessed earth, flat cartoon colors and slightly overhead ground perspective. Reference image 2 is the game's atlas; the open hand in row 2 column 1 defines the impact outline: one thumb on LEFT plus four fingers pointing UP, five digits TOTAL.
The ENTIRE hole must follow that open palm silhouette, including clearly separated finger-shaped recesses. Broad rounded palm depression, four long finger trenches and one shorter thumb trench connected to it, visible dark inner earthen walls that show depth BELOW ground. No round or oval crater enclosing a hand; the excavated outline itself IS the five-finger hand. A thin broken tan earth rim follows all five fingers and palm, a few small radial cracks and small stones. No actual hand, no skin, no pink, no palm drawn on top of a circle, no fire, no magic glow, no gore. Match the game's friendly uncomplicated doodle style. Readable at small size. Centered complete single sprite with generous transparent margin on ALL sides. True alpha transparent background outside the crater and cracks, no solid background, no text.

Use case: style-transfer. Game sprite. Use the attached atlas as STYLE reference only. Recreate ONLY the long, slim, face-free green cactus at the TOP LEFT, as one standalone sprite, substantially more dangerous and spiky.
One elongated straight green cucumber-shaped cactus barrel, vertically oriented, length at least 4 times the GREEN BODY width; simple dark-green lengthwise ribs. Add many very obvious LONG sharp ivory triangular cactus thorns with thick near-black outlines, about 7-9 outward spikes per side and a few on its front ribs and rounded ends. The spikes must look pointed and strong at small game size, not blunt black hairs, not tiny dots. Preserve the original cute hand-drawn doodle game's thick wobbly outlines and simple flat light/dark green palette. No face, eyes, mouth, arms, feet, pot or branches. No metallic parts. No glow, motion, extra objects, text or background. One complete centered vertical cactus, including all spike tips, with generous empty margins. True alpha transparent background.

Use case: style-transfer. Transparent 2D doodle game sprite. The attached game atlas is a STYLE reference. Create one standalone missile based on its red missile in row 2 column 2, with EXACT colors: red pointed nose cone/warhead, RED tail fins/wings, WHITE cylindrical main body. Thick slightly wobbly black outline, simple flat colors, a small pale gray shadow on white body, friendly hand-drawn style matching the game's player. No face, no text, no markings. One complete missile perfectly HORIZONTAL with its pointed red NOSE toward the RIGHT and red fins at LEFT; this orientation is required for game movement. Small orange/yellow exhaust flame behind left end, no detached particles. Centered with large transparent margin all sides, true alpha transparent background. Only ONE missile, no panels.

Use case: compositing. Create a transparent sprite sheet with TWO separate square game-skill icons arranged in one row: LEFT cactus volley, RIGHT missile volley. The reference images are the exact designs to use, do not redesign them.
LEFT: exactly FOUR long slim green cactuses from image 1, with prominent long sharp ivory triangular spikes, thick black outlines, no faces. Arrange four separate complete cactuses diagonally at varied heights, two large and two smaller, with a few simple black motion strokes.
RIGHT: exactly THREE missiles from image 2 flying diagonally toward upper right, each red nose cone and red fins with WHITE main body, small orange-yellow exhaust and black motion strokes.
Keep the same simple hand-drawn doodle art style, thick black outlines, flat colors. All objects fully visible; no overlap between the two icons. Wide empty transparent vertical gutter at the center and generous transparent margins all around; each group wholly in its own half. True transparent alpha background, no frames, no letters, no labels, no panels or extra assets. Landscape canvas.
